name: FLIR Lepton 3.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Primary recommended thermal core. Export-controlled; international orders require an End Use Statement. Wide-angle alternative: optional FLIR Lepton 3.1R (95 deg HFOV, 500-0758-03).

name: FLIR Lepton 3.1R Wide-Angle Thermal Module
value_spec: 160x120 LWIR, Radiometric, 95 deg HFOV (119 deg DFOV), Shutter
notes: Optional 95 deg wide-angle alternative to Lepton 3.5 (not in the required total). The enclosure clears its full 119 deg diagonal field of view.

name: FLIR Lepton 2.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Optional budget alternative to Lepton 3.5 (excluded from required total). FLIR EOL notice (last buy Sept 2027); prefer Lepton 3.5 or 3.1R.

name: Teensy 4.1 Development Board
value_spec: ARM Cortex-M7 600MHz, 8MB Flash, microSD, with pins
notes: Buy the version with pins (also at Adafruit, ID 4622). Leave its five inner pads empty: spring pins P3/P4 on the board touch VBAT and PROGRAM. If pins are soldered there, cut them flush underneath first; never force the Teensy down.

name: 3.2 Inch 240x320 TFT LCD Touch Display
value_spec: ILI9341 4-Wire SPI, 5V Supply, XPT2046 Resistive Touch
notes: Select exact options: Pin Header 4-Wire SPI, 5V Power Supply, 3.2-inch Resistive Touch Panel, No Font Chip. 2x20 2.54mm header pinout.

name: 32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC Card
notes: Any 16GB-32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC formatted FAT32 or exFAT works reliably with Teensy 4.1 SDIO.

name: DIY-Thermocam 2-Layer PCB
notes: Estimated per-board cost at qty 5 without assembly or shipping. Order files for JLCPCB, Seeed Fusion and PCBWay are in hardware/pcb/fab/.

name: DIY-Thermocam Enclosure
notes: Generated from hardware/enclosure/ (STEP, STL, 3MF, laser SVG/DXF). Price: the 3D-printed shell set, 8 parts including the two battery spacers (76.2 cm3), in MJF PA12 at JLC3DP, excluding shipping. Printed walls are at least 1.0 mm and details at least 0.8 mm, JLC3DP's MJF minimums.

name: FR4 Battery Floor and Lid
value_spec: Bare FR4, no copper, black solder mask: 0.6 mm cradle floor + 0.4 mm lid
notes: Gerbers in hardware/enclosure/exports/fr4/; same boards for the printed shell and the acrylic case. Per-camera share of two 5-board orders (2.00 USD each at JLCPCB), excluding shipping.

name: M2.5 Standoffs, Nylon Washers and Screws
value_spec: 4x M2.5x20 F-F hex SW5 (005.02.205), 4x M2.5x11 M-F hex SW5 (005.12.119), 4x nylon washer 2.7/6.0 x 0.5 (003.03.026) on the rear standoffs, 4x M2.5x6 + 4x M2.5x14 ISO 7046 countersunk (001.12.228, 082.22.212)
notes: Per-camera share of Ettinger 100-packs (net, 1.10 USD/EUR). The washers keep the rear standoffs' hex corners off the SW2/SW3 pads. Laser case: use 4x M2.5x8 + 4x M2.5x14 ISO 7045 pan heads (001.17.232, 001.17.298) instead of the countersunk screws, each on a 003.03.026 washer. Brass 005.12.115 can replace the stainless 11 mm standoff (100-day lead time).

name: M2 Lepton Carrier Fasteners
notes: Per-camera share of Ettinger 100-packs (net, 1.10 USD/EUR). Screw heads sit on the display side of the main PCB on the nylon washers, which keep them off the D4/D26 tracks; the nuts go on the carrier side. Tighten the nuts snug with a 4 mm nut driver over a drop of medium-strength removable threadlocker (e.g. Loctite 243).

name: 1/4-20 UNC Hex Nut (Tripod Mount)
value_spec: 1/4-20 UNC hex nut, 7/16 in AF x 5.5 mm, zinc-plated steel
notes: Same nut in both enclosures: captive in the shell's bottom boss, or in the printed tripod_mount of the laser case. Takes tripod screws up to 8 mm long.

name: Slim Protected 3.7V 1200mAh LiPo Battery (Adafruit 258)
notes: Adafruit 258 is the reference cell: protected, JST-PH 2-pin with documented polarity. It sits in the battery cradle between the two printed spacer bars (battery_spacer, in the print set). The lead route to J4 needs about 45mm; Adafruit doesn't state the lead length, so check it on arrival. More runtime: the ampul.eu 505060 2000mAh cell (5.0x50x60mm, EUR 7.29) also fits, but its page lists no plug, lead length or polarity: confirm a JST-PH plug, at least 50mm of lead and + on the marked pin before ordering. Any cell must be <=5.0mm thick (5.5mm max swell). Check + against the J4 silkscreen before plugging in.

name: USB-A to USB-C Data/Power Cable
notes: One USB-C cable for charging, USB streaming and Teensy firmware updates.

name: TI BQ24074 Li-Ion Power-Path Charger IC
value_spec: 1.5A Dynamic Power-Path Charger, 4.4V VSYS, ITERM Pin
notes: USB-C charger with power path: runs the camera from USB and charges the battery at the same time. R11=1.2k (1.3A input limit), R10=1.5k (~590mA charge, keeps the charger cooler inside the case), R23=3.0k (60mA termination), R14=47k (~6.3h timer).

name: TI TPS61022 Synchronous 5V Boost Converter
value_spec: 8A Switch, 5.0V Out (R16=732k / R17=100k), True Load Disconnect
notes: Small-reel (RWUT) version of the TPS61022RWUR (C915088): same chip and package, and JLCPCB stocks it when the large reel runs out. 5.0V boost for Teensy, display and Lepton. SW1 drives its EN pin; in shutdown the output is fully disconnected, so the battery still charges while the camera is off.

name: XC6206P332MR-G 3.3V Low-Quiescent RTC LDO
notes: Powers Teensy 4.1 VBAT (VDD_SNVS_IN 2.4-3.6V) from the battery at ~1uA, so the clock keeps time without a coin cell. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0uH 15A Shielded Power Inductor
notes: Power inductor for the TPS61022 boost converter (U2).

name: 2A Resettable PTC Polyfuse (1206)
notes: Battery overcurrent protection after the Q1/Q2 reverse-polarity circuit.

name: USB 2.0 ESD Protection Diode Array
notes: Protects Teensy USB D+/D- differential pair at board-edge USB-C receptacle J3.

name: Red 0603 SMD Charging Status LED
notes: Driven by BQ24074 open-drain ~CHG pin (lit while charging). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: AO3401A P-Channel MOSFET (Reverse-Polarity)
notes: Primary active reverse-polarity LiPo protection MOSFET on J4. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: AO3400A N-Channel MOSFET (Gate Interlock)
notes: Gate interlock keeping Q1 hard-OFF into a reversed LiPo even when USB-C is plugged in (<10uA quiescent). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: USB Type-C 16-Pin SMD Receptacle
value_spec: USB 2.0 Power + D+/D- Right-Angle, mouth 0.3mm past the board edge
notes: Board-edge USB-C port feeding BQ24074 IN and Teensy 4.1 D+/D- pogo pins P1/P2.

name: JST-PH 2.0mm 2-Pin SMD Battery Header
notes: Standard Adafruit/SparkFun LiPo polarity (always verify +/- silkscreen before connecting). Protected by Q1/Q2 + F1.

name: 2x20 (40-Pin) Female Display Socket
notes: Top-side socket for the BuyDisplay ER-TFTM032-3. The only part on the top side (through-hole).

name: 2x10 (20-Pin) Female Lepton Socket
value_spec: 2.54mm Pitch, Dual Row, Straight, Through-Hole, 8.5mm Height
notes: Bottom-side socket for the Lepton carrier's straight 2x10 header (J101), which goes about 5 mm deep. Plain socket, 25.8 x 5.0 mm body; do not substitute a wider box-header socket.

name: 1x24 (24-Pin) Female Teensy Socket
notes: Bottom-side sockets for a pre-pinned Teensy 4.1. 8.5mm socket + 2.5mm header plastic = 11mm, the pogo pins' working height.

name: DIY-Thermocam Lepton Carrier PCB
notes: Second small board that holds the Lepton and plugs straight into J2. Order it assembled from the same fab as the main board; files are in hardware/pcb/fab/ (diy-thermocam-v4.0-lepton-*). Estimated per-board cost at qty 5 without assembly or shipping.

name: Molex 105028-1001 Lepton Socket
value_spec: 32-Contact SMD Socket for FLIR Lepton 2.x/3.x, Gold Contacts
notes: Holds the Lepton on the carrier. JLCPCB often has none in stock: pre-order it in JLCPCB's parts manager (minimum 9) before ordering assembly. The silkscreen circle marks the socket's floor hole next to pin 1.

name: 2x10 Straight Male Header (Lepton Carrier)
value_spec: 2.54mm Pitch, Dual Row, 2.5mm Body, 6mm Mating Pin, 3mm Tail, Through-Hole
notes: Carrier side of the Lepton link: plugs straight into J2 on the main board, about 5 mm deep with a 1 mm gap left. Breakout V2 pin numbers; only the pins J2 uses are connected. Do not substitute a header with a different body or pin length.

name: TI TLV62568 1A Step-Down Converter (Lepton VDDC)
notes: Lepton core supply VDDC (1.14-1.26 V allowed). Replaces the breakout's AAT1146 buck.

name: ME6211C28 2.8V LDO (Lepton VDD)
notes: Lepton sensor supply VDD (2.72-2.88 V allowed). Replaces the breakout's FT533GA.

name: ME6211C30 3.0V LDO (Lepton VDDIO)
notes: Lepton I/O supply VDDIO (2.8-3.1 V allowed). 3.0 V instead of the breakout's 2.8 V leaves more margin to the main board's 3.3 V I2C pull-ups and SPI levels.

name: 25MHz MEMS Oscillator (Lepton Master Clock)
notes: Lepton MASTER_CLK, powered from VDDIO (3.0 V). The Lepton needs 3.4 ns or faster edges; this part guarantees 2 ns (20-80 %) at 15 pF. Do not substitute: most 25 MHz oscillators allow 4-5 ns. JLCPCB has no stored footprint for it yet, so its engineer places it from the pads.

name: 2.2uH Power Inductor (Lepton VDDC Buck)
notes: TLV62568 inductor (TI recommends 2.2 uH).

name: 1uF 50V X5R 0603 MLCC Capacitor
notes: Lepton carrier: LDO input/output capacitors (C103-C105) and the RESET_L delay capacitor (C111). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: SMD Spring Pogo Pin (12.0mm Free / 11.0mm Working)
notes: Spring contacts under the Teensy 4.1, so nothing is soldered to it. P1/P2 press on the USB D+/D- pads and carry USB data from the USB-C port. P3 (VBAT, clock supply) and P4 (PROGRAM, pinhole button) sit 0.5 mm off the centre of the 0.965 mm inner holes so the domed 0.9 mm tip rests on the hole's copper ring.

name: Right-Angle SMD Slide Power Switch
notes: Board-edge power switch on the TPS61022 EN pin (the battery keeps charging while off). Operated through the enclosure's slide_switch_cap.

name: Right-Angle SMD Tactile Capture Switch
notes: Board-edge capture button on Teensy pin 2. Operated through the enclosure's capture_button.

name: SMD Tactile PROG Switch
notes: Pressed through a pinhole in the back shell to start the Teensy bootloader. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 10uF 25V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: BQ24074 IN/OUT/BAT and rail decoupling capacitors (C1-C10); on the Lepton carrier, U101 input (C101) and VDDIO output (C106). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 100nF 50V X7R 0603 MLCC Capacitor
notes: High-frequency bypass for the power, ESD and RTC LDO rails, and the battery ADC input filter (C12). On the Lepton carrier: VDDC, VDDIO and VDD at the socket (C107-C109) and the 25 MHz oscillator (C110). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 22uF 25V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: TPS61022 input/output capacitors next to U2 (C4, C8, C9); on the Lepton carrier, the VDDC buck output (C102). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 47k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 ~6.3h safety timer (R14) and reverse-polarity gate bias (R20). On the Lepton carrier: RESET_L pull-up (R103, with C111 about 30 ms reset delay, well after the 5 ms clock start-up). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 470k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Battery ADC divider upper leg (R1, with R2 = 1M): same 0.68 ratio as before, about 2.5 uA battery drain. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1M Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Battery ADC divider lower leg (R2, filtered by C12). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: ~CHG LED current limiter (R12). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.5k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 R_ISET: about 590mA charge current (890 A-ohm / 1.5k), which keeps the charger cooler inside the case. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.2k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 R_ILIM (1.3A USB input current limit, >= TI 1.1k minimum). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 100k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: VBUS ADC divider (R3, R5), TPS61022 EN pull-down (R15), FB lower leg (R17), and R24 across Q1 so a fully drained pack can be recharged. On the Lepton carrier: VDDC feedback divider (R101/R102, 1.2 V) and PWR_DWN_L pull-up (R104). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 750k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Ultra-low-drain Q1/Q2 gate interlock pull resistors (R18, R21).

name: 732k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: TPS61022 FB upper leg: 0.6V x (1 + 732k/100k) = 5.0V, inside the display's 4.8-5.2V range across the reference tolerance. In JLCPCB stock with a minimum of 1 (UNI-ROYAL C23239 needs a 4749-piece pre-order); FOJAN FRC0603F7323TS (C5159703) is an equal substitute.

name: 10k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 TS pull-down (R9), LCD backlight pull-up (R19), and BQ24074 EN2 pull-up to regulated VSYS (R22). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 3.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 ITERM termination programming resistor (10.1% of the charge current

name: 4.7k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: I2C SDA0/SCL0 pull-up resistors for FLIR Lepton CCI (R4, R6). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 5.1k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Mandatory USB-C CC1 and CC2 sink pull-downs to request 5V from USB-C PD chargers. JLCPCB Basic part.
